projects.title: Fantasy Basketball Wizard - Chrome Extension
projects.description:
- Collaborated in developing a web browser plugin with 6000+ users designed to add incredibly useful features to Yahoo and ESPN fantasy basketball applications
- Created to properly aggregate player statistics data and produce useful info, such as weekly stats projections and other statistics helpful for strength comparison against competitors
- Maintained, fixed, and improved features on ESPN side of the extension by debugging and implementing with JavaScript, CSS, and HTML

projects.title: GameEnviro (Java)
projects.description:
- Jointly developed and designed a GUI-based board game environment with Eclipse and Swing that accommodates any board game that involves a grid layout and game elements
- Combined the usage of a HashMap and .txt files to create, load, and save scores for every game session
- Built individual classes for the board, pieces, and interaction/patterns to allow for inheritance and simpler addition and implementation of games
- Contributed to the addition of games such as Checkers, Tic-Tac-Toe, Battleship, Memory, and Reversi
